oliver_pm: Quick sync — we need to pick a prioritization + rollout plan for Adaptive Routing feature. Customers asking for lower tail latency. Thinking RICE to pick slices and an incremental canary for risk management. any strong opinions? 

sasha_eng: RICE is fine but let's be pragmatic. Impact = p95 reduction for top 10% customers. Effort high because of routing infra. 

jay_product: Agree. Also need launch criteria: p95 down >= 12% AND no increased error_rate > 0.5% in canary window. 

priya_research: +1. Also we should bake in quality checks (LLM output drift) — add embeddings regression test. 

sasha_eng: Proposal for sequencing: small functional canary 1% (30m), ramp 5% (2h), 25% (6h), 100% next day if green. Auto-fallback to previous route on any signal. 

oliver_pm: sounds reasonable. How do we score RICE? quick draft: Reach = number of affected requests/day (est 2M) -> 8, Impact (p95) = 5, Confidence = 0.6, Effort = 13 engineer-weeks -> RICE = (8*5*0.6)/13 ~1.85. Thoughts? 

jay_product: Could we break effort into infra vs model work and run parallel experiments to lower effort? 

sasha_eng: yeah, split can reduce serial work. infra (6w) + model-tuning (7w) -> we can canary infra first with existing model for safety. 

priya_research: For metrics, track: p95_latency, p99_latency, error_rate, gen_quality_score, token_cost_delta. Also small human eval batch every ramp step. 

oliver_pm: Good. Need engineering owners and rollback plan in runbook. @sasha_eng volunteer? 

sasha_eng: I can own canary infra + runbook. @jay_product handle launch criteria and comms. 

deploy-bot: deploy started by sasha_eng at 2026-03-20T15:04:00Z

sasha_eng: starting 1% canary now. watch p95 and error_rate. ping if any anomalies :eyes: 

jay_product: adding note to roadmap doc and gating next step on metrics thresholds. Will update PRD. 

oliver_pm: thanks. we'll reconvene after 25% ramp or earlier if issues. 

priya_research: I'll run the first eval set in 30m and share notes. 

sasha_eng: update — 1% canary stable at 45m, p95 down 10%, no error uptick. proceeding to 5%. :thumbsup: 

jay_product: on 5% now, running human eval. if gen_quality_score drop <2% then continue. 

oliver_pm: perfect. document looks good. thanks everyone.
